question: Please examine our database records for Chinese cities (country_code_2 = 'cn') during July 2021 and identify both the shortest and longest streaks of consecutive date entries. For each date in these streaks, return exactly one record per date along with the corresponding city name. In your output, please ensure the first letter of each city name is capitalized and the rest are lowercase. Display the dates and city names for both the shortest and longest consecutive date streaks, ordered by date.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT city_id, city_name, insert_date,
         CAST(strftime('%J', insert_date) AS INTEGER) AS j
  FROM cities
  WHERE country_code_2 = 'cn' AND insert_date LIKE '2021-07%'
),
grp AS (
  SELECT city_id, city_name, insert_date, j,
         j - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY j) AS grp
  FROM base
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT grp, MIN(j) AS min_j, MAX(j) AS max_j,
         MAX(j) - MIN(j) + 1 AS len
  FROM grp
  GROUP BY grp
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT MIN(len) AS min_len, MAX(len) AS max_len FROM streaks
)
SELECT g.insert_date AS date,
       UPPER(SUBSTR(g.city_name,1,1)) || LOWER(SUBSTR(g.city_name,2)) AS city_name
FROM grp g
JOIN streaks s ON s.grp = g.grp
CROSS JOIN bounds b
WHERE s.len IN (b.min_len, b.max_len)
ORDER BY g.insert_date, g.city_id

persistent_recovery_advisory_draft.base_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT city_id, city_name, insert_date,
         CAST(strftime('%J', insert_date) AS INTEGER) AS j
  FROM cities
  WHERE country_code_2 = 'cn' AND insert_date LIKE '2021-07%'
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT b.*,
         CASE WHEN LAG(j) OVER (ORDER BY j) = j - 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_start
  FROM base b
),
grp AS (
  SELECT *,
         SUM(is_start) OVER (ORDER BY j ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS grp
  FROM flagged
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT grp, MIN(j) AS min_j, MAX(j) AS max_j,
         MAX(j) - MIN(j) + 1 AS len
  FROM grp
  GROUP BY grp
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT MIN(len) AS min_len, MAX(len) AS max_len FROM streaks
),
sel AS (
  SELECT g.j, g.city_id, g.city_name
  FROM grp g
  JOIN streaks s ON g.grp = s.grp
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE s.len = b.min_len OR s.len = b.max_len
)
SELECT DISTINCT
       date(julianday('2000-01-01') + (j - 2451545)) AS date,
       capitalize(city_name) AS city_name
FROM sel
ORDER BY date
